q: A saddle–node bifurcation occurs when two fixed points collide and annihilate. The normal form is:
exp: Saddle–node (fold) normal form: ẋ = μ - x². For μ>0 there are two fixed points (√μ stable, -√μ unstable); at μ=0 they collide; for μ<0 there are none. This is the generic codimension-1 local bifurcation.
